result.stdout:
vidyano — run .visc scripts against a Vidyano service

Usage:
  vidyano run   <file.visc> [options]   Execute a script.
  vidyano lint  <file.visc>                  Parse-check without executing.
  vidyano repl  [options]                     Start an interactive .visc REPL.
  vidyano help  [verbs]                      Show help. 'verbs' lists every 
.visc verb.

Options shared by run/repl:
  --app <uri>            Base URI of the Vidyano service (overrides script's 
@app).
  --var key=value        Pre-seed a script variable. Repeatable.
  --mode navigation|audit|direct
                          Guard mode (overrides script's @mode).
  --tools <path.dll>      Load an external tool pack (IVidyanoScriptToolPack). 
Repeatable.
  --seed <int>           Fix the {{@uuid}}/{{@random}} sequence (next value per 
reference).
  --now <iso-datetime>   Anchor the run clock for {{@today}}/{{@now}} (then 
flows by real elapsed).
  --json                   NDJSON output (one event per line).
  --verbose                Show per-statement snapshot detail.
  --insecure               Bypass TLS validation (local dev certs only).

Exit codes:  0 ok, 1 failed, 2 parse error, 3 connection error, 64 usage.
